title: Google AI plans with Cloud Storage - Google One

facts.fact: Students get Google AI Pro free for 1 year, with higher access to Gemini, a 24/7 personal AI agent, and 5 TB of storage.
facts.quote: Students get Google AI Pro free for 1 year. Study smarter with higher access to Gemini, a 24/7 personal AI agent, and 5 TB of storage.

facts.fact: The Google AI Plus plan includes 400 GB of storage.
facts.quote: 400 GB of cloud storage across Gmail, Drive, and Photos.

facts.fact: The Google AI Pro plan includes 5 TB of storage.
facts.quote: 5 TB of cloud storage across Gmail, Drive, and Photos.

facts.fact: The Google AI Ultra plan starts at 20 TB of storage.
Google says the AI Pro plan offers four times more access to Gemini.
facts.quote: Create faster and get more done with four times more access to Gemini

facts.fact: Google says the AI Ultra plan has 5x higher usage limits in Gemini than the AI Pro plan.
facts.quote: Accelerate your workflows with 5x higher usage limits in Gemini than the AI Pro plan

facts.fact: Google says the AI Plus plan provides double the access to Gemini.
facts.quote: Unlock essential tools to boost productivity with double the access to Gemini

facts.fact: The Google AI Plus and Google AI Pro plans both allow family sharing with up to five others.
facts.quote: Family sharing with up to five others.

facts.fact: The Google AI Pro plan includes 200 compute units per month in Google Colab, according to Google.
facts.quote: Get expanded access to powerful accelerators and longer runtimes in Google Colab with 200 compute units per month.

facts.fact: The Google AI Pro plan includes $10 in monthly Google Cloud credits from the Google Developer Program.
facts.quote: $10 in monthly Google Cloud credits from Google Developer Program.

facts.fact: The Google AI Pro plan includes the Google Home Premium Standard plan at no cost, which Google values at $10 per month.
facts.quote: Get the Google Home Premium Standard plan at no cost ($10/mo value), with 30 days of event history and Gemini features.

facts.fact: Google states that subscribers can cancel anytime.
Google AI Pro includes YouTube Premium Lite, with availability varying by country.
facts.quote: Enjoy YouTube with fewer ads, offline, and in the background with the YouTube Premium Lite plan (availability varies by country).
